summary.zh: 分离读写模型以独立扩展查询与写入
summary.en: Separate read and write models for independent scaling

description.zh: 说明命令与查询如何分离、读写两侧各自的数据模型与一致性取舍，以及和事件溯源配合时的同步方式。适合查询压力大的系统、需要独立扩展读侧，或读写模型差异明显时参考。
description.en: Explains how commands and queries split, the separate models and consistency tradeoffs on each side, and how the read side syncs when paired with event sourcing. Use it when reads need independent scaling or the two models diverge.
